'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Phillip Aasen LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Phillip Aasen]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Sheet line 34 Alderaan Blown Away Asteroid Field (V) → [[Alderaan (Blown Away)]]. Line 49 Corellian Retort (V) (not Slip).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Phillip Aasen]]

* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Watch Your Step]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
